summary: DSS, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement with related party Alset Inc., which loaned $500,000 in exchange for a convertible promissory note and warrants covering 8,000,000 shares. The note bears 3% simple interest, is payable on demand, converts at $0.50 per share, and matures in five years; warrants strike $0.55 and expire in five years. Stockholder approval is required before conversion or exercise. Approved by the board and audit committee. This is a routine related-party financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and approval risk.
